description: Create or update App Store review contact and demo sign-in for the current version (iris appStoreReviewDetail). Required before press_submit_for_review for login apps.

demo_account_name.description: Required when the app has sign-in (default). Omit only if requires_demo_account is false.

demo_account_password.description: Demo password for App Review. Pair with demo_account_name.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

requires_demo_account.description: Default true. Set false only when the app has no user sign-in.

name: update_app_review_information
